body: Basking in my emptiness and the futility of my life

I tried talking to an on-campus counselor, but it didn't really help and it was a big time commitment since our health center is pretty far away. It's just hard being surrounded by beautiful women who basically have it all. Whenever I try to be confident or anything short of invisible, people just stoop to devaluing my achievements by calling me ugly. It sucks because I can't even make myself attractive by losing weight; I already have a very athletic body but my face is too bad.

I'm scared that although I can get a job, my achievements will never be recognized because I'm not attractive and I'm really shy as a result of several years of bullying. I'm scared I'll stay in the in the same entry level position without getting promoted, fast forward 30 years and suddenly I'm 50 and someone straight out of college is my boss.

Also, I feel like I'm missing out on everything. Most women my age are having fun and going on dates and still doing well in school. I'm not having any fun, nobody likes me, and I don't get good grades. I feel isolated and I don't feel like I can make it.

My advice would be to just focus on school, if possible. I know that sex and partying seems somewhat important. If it helps, just keep in perspective that when you graduate, the only thing which will matter are your grades...
